source_steps.text: For every r, the equality of real absolute values also gives equality of the same nonnegative quantities regarded in [0,infinity].
Apply congruence of the supremum to those pointwise equal extended nonnegative values. No finiteness or boundedness assumption is needed, including for an empty index type.
